prompt:
You are the requirements analyst of an AI agent factory. A requester wants an AI assistant
that answers questions from a set of documents. Read the BRIEF and the DOCUMENT OVERVIEW and
draft the requirements.

BRIEF:
I need an assistant for ship agents bringing vessels into the Port of Kochi. It should explain arrival notice deadlines, pilotage and berthing rules, safety permits and crew shore leave, look up port fees and calculate the total cost of a port call, tell agents how many days are left until a notice deadline from today, and give the current weather forecast at the port.

DOCUMENT OVERVIEW:
- crew_shore_leave.md (md, 1 page(s), 160 words)
  keywords: crew, shore, kochi, pass, must, hour, vessel, centre
  starts: # Port of Kochi - Crew Shore Leave (fictional training document) ## Shore passes Crew members may go ashore with a shore pass issued by the immigration office at the port gate. The ship agent must submit the crew list to immigration at least 24 hours before arrival. Shore passes
- port_fees.csv (csv, 1 page(s), 19 words)
  keywords: per, fee, tug, code, item, unit, amount, inr
  starts: CSV columns: fee_code,fee_item,unit,amount_inr; 10 rows
- port_rules.pdf (pdf, 2 page(s), 208 words)
  keywords: vessel, hour, arrival, least, port, must, harbour, before
  starts: Port of Kochi - Rules for Visiting Vessels (2026, fictional training document) 1. Arrival notice Ship agents must send the pre-arrival notice to the Harbour Master at least 72 hours before the vessel's expected arrival. Vessels carrying dangerous goods must send the dangerous goods declaration at least 48 hours before

Write:
- agent_name: 2-4 lowercase words joined by underscores, e.g. "hr_policy_assistant"
- purpose: one sentence: what the assistant does and for whom
- scope: one or two sentences: what it covers
- audience: who will use it
- tone: e.g. "formal and concise"
- must_answer_topics: 3-10 short topics the assistant must answer. Use topics the BRIEF asks for.
- must_refuse_topics: 2-6 short topics it must refuse (outside the brief, or risky: legal, medical, personal data...)

These are DESIGN requirements for the assistant, not answers to employees' questions.

Reply with JSON only.
raw_output:
{
  "agent_name": "kochi_agent_assistant",
  "purpose": "Provides answers to questions related to vessel arrivals, crew shore leave, port fees, and weather forecasts for the Port of Kochi.",
  "scope": "The assistant will cover arrival notice deadlines, pilotage and berthing rules, safety permits, port fees, and current weather forecasts for the Port of Kochi.",
  "audience": "Ship agents and other personnel working in the Port of Kochi.",
  "tone": "Formal and concise",
  "must_answer_topics": [
    "arrival notice deadlines",
    "pilotage and berthing rules",
    "safety permits",
    "port fees",
    "days until notice deadline",
    "current weather forecast"
  ],
  "must_refuse_topics": [
    "legal",
    "medical",
    "personal data"
  ]
}
